status: INCOMPLETE — two candidates cannot be suppressed as specified
what_pass_means: the frozen build emits a payload carrying the decision's ruling and reason for the recorded path scope, removing the target record by identity drops both from the payload, and every unrelated record block is byte-identical between the arms

harness_faults_found_and_fixed.truth: agent-operator-score's sealed bundle carries no refs/notes/commitlore because that repository never had one, so unfetched there is the state of the repository rather than a step skipped. gitseed's bundle does carry it and fetching changes only the timestamp, the notes field and one diagnostic -- the record set is identical.

harness_faults_found_and_fixed.fault: treated a non-zero exit as a refusal
harness_faults_found_and_fixed.truth: asking for six paths at once exits 3 with a note that rename following needs one pathspec, and prints the complete answer on stdout regardless
harness_faults_found_and_fixed.cost: failed 8 candidates a second time, for a different wrong reason

harness_faults_found_and_fixed.fault: quoted repository paths into a shell command line
harness_faults_found_and_fixed.truth: path scope entries are data; the harness now passes an argument array
harness_faults_found_and_fixed.cost: masked the exit-code fault while it was present

genuine_failures.problem: the source pool records no record_id for this decision
genuine_failures.consequence: suppression is specified as removal by structured record identity. With no record id there is no identity to remove, and the payload for its path scope carries 66 records that this arm would have to separate some other way.
genuine_failures.not_attempted: a text filter would delete whatever happens to read like the ruling

genuine_failures.problem: removing the target record does not remove the ruling from the payload
genuine_failures.found: three separate decisions in this repository rule out the same approach for different reasons: r-f8adapter (atomic artifact constraints), r-f8replay (a single durable run history) and r-f8schema (version gating and correction lineage). Suppressing one leaves the other two, so the SUPPRESSED arm still tells the agent that JSON files on disk were ruled out.
genuine_failures.and_one_of_them_is_another_candidate: r-f8replay is the target record of v4-ed878960135ff45a, which is also in the seventeen. Suppressing both to clean one arm would alter the other candidate's ON payload.

why_this_is_not_a_harness_fault: both failures reproduce with the frozen build run by hand. The first is missing data in the source pool; the second is a property of the repository, where one approach was ruled out three times.
